goal: Prevent memory exhaustion and DoS attacks caused by blocks containing millions of tiny witness elements
Speed up block deserialization and immediately reject malformed transactions before allocating memory
agreement: Broad concept support for fixing the witness memory exhaustion issue (furszy, 0xB10C, instagibbs, fanquake)
Approach approval with suggestions on scope and parameter handling (ajtowns)
Unaddressed objection: abstract data access before changing internal layouts (purpleKarrot)
Answered objection: script verification allocates memory for unknown witness versions (fametrano)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it stops peers from exhausting node memory using messages with millions of witness items
Drops malformed or oversized transactions during wire deserialization before validation runs

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it eliminates a severe validation memory amplification DoS vector
Block deserialization peak memory drops from 182 MiB to 8 MiB and deserialization time falls by over 93%
